items.title: Stephen Miller promoted to chief of staff amid immigration hardline concerns
items.feedTitle: Stephen Miller, Trump's new chief of staff, is the architect of his controversial immigration policies
items.summary: President Trump has elevated Stephen Miller, the architect of his controversial immigration policies, to White House chief of staff, replacing Susie Wiles. The move signals Trump intends to double down on hardline immigration enforcement despite Republican midterm losses. Miller pledged "absolute loyalty" to Trump at a Mar-a-Lago event. Democrats and some Republicans have criticized the decision, with Senator Thom Tillis calling it the "worst of all possible choices." The promotion comes after Democrats' sweeping victories in the midterms, which party strategists attribute partly to backlash against Trump's immigration record.

items.title: House Republicans battle for leadership after historic midterm losses
items.feedTitle: Two House Republicans battle to lead the party’s diminished ranks
items.summary: Two House Republicans are competing to lead the party's diminished ranks following the GOP's significant losses in the midterm elections. Speaker Mike Johnson has announced he will step aside as Republican leader after the party lost control of the House. The leadership race reflects internal GOP fracturing as Republicans reckon with their electoral defeat and debate the party's direction forward.

items.title: North Carolina GOP suffers continued losses in midterm wave
items.feedTitle: From Powerhouse to Punchline: The North Carolina G.O.P. Implosion
items.summary: Republicans in North Carolina lost four additional House seats as part of the broader Democratic midterm wave, marking a historic implosion of the once-powerful state GOP apparatus. The losses contributed to Democrats flipping multiple statewide races across the country. North Carolina, once a Republican stronghold, exemplifies the scope of the party's midterm collapse.

items.title: Former Wisconsin governor declares state now solidly blue
items.feedTitle: Former GOP governor: 'Wisconsin is a blue state'
items.summary: Former GOP Governor Tommy Thompson stated that Wisconsin is no longer a purple state after recent statewide defeats for Republicans, including losses in the gubernatorial race. The declaration reflects how midterm results have shifted long-competitive states toward Democrats. Wisconsin has not elected a Republican to statewide office recently, marking a significant shift in the political landscape.

items.title: South Carolina Republicans fracture after stunning Democratic Senate win
items.feedTitle: South Carolina Republicans Fracture Over Stunning Defeat of Darline Graham
items.summary: Republicans in South Carolina are divided following the stunning election of Democrat Annie Andrews to the U.S. Senate in a seat long held by the GOP in a deep-red state. Her victory represents one of the most unexpected Democratic wins of the midterm cycle. Political observers cite "generational change" as Andrews, a newcomer, defeated the Republican incumbent, signaling a potential realignment in the state.

stlouis.title: Saint Louis defeats Missouri 90-84 in Show Me Showdown
stlouis.feedTitle: Saint Louis University Billikens defeat Missouri Tigers 90-84 in Show Me Showdown
stlouis.summary: Saint Louis University's Billikens defeated the University of Missouri Tigers 90-84 in the annual Show Me Showdown rivalry game. McCottry and Sharma each scored 17 points for Saint Louis, which made 14 three-pointers to secure the victory. The Billikens' strong three-point shooting proved decisive in the matchup between the two in-state rivals.

stlouis.title: Jason Driver named new St. Louis Public Library CEO
stlouis.feedTitle: Jason Driver named St. Louis Public Library CEO
stlouis.summary: Jason Driver has been appointed as the new chief executive officer of the St. Louis Public Library, taking over leadership of the major regional institution. The appointment marks a significant personnel change at the library system, which serves the St. Louis metro area.

stlouis.title: Ascension to cut 51 jobs as St. Louis County operation closes
stlouis.feedTitle: Ascension to cut 51 jobs as St. Louis County operation closes
stlouis.summary: Ascension Health announced it will eliminate 51 jobs as it closes an operation in St. Louis County. The healthcare system's decision reflects broader industry consolidation and restructuring in the region. The closure will impact local employment and healthcare service delivery in the county.

items.title: Five killed, at least 12 injured in Krakow shooting rampage
items.feedTitle: Gunman opens fire in Polish city of Krakow, killing 5 people and injuring at least 12
items.summary: A gunman opened fire near the main market square in Poland's second-largest city, Krakow, killing five people and injuring at least a dozen others. Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk called it a "tragic" attack and said police are investigating. The U.S. ambassador to Poland condemned the "savage and murderous attack" as the nation reels from the violence.

items.title: New Zealand election too close to call amid coalition talks
items.feedTitle: New Zealand faces weeks of uncertainty with election ‘too close to call’
items.summary: New Zealand's election has ended in a near-deadlock with no clear winner, likely setting up weeks of coalition negotiations to form a government. Prime Minister Christopher Luxon said he has a pathway to form the next government, but the razor-thin margins mean minor parties will hold significant power in determining the outcome. Political uncertainty will dominate New Zealand for coming weeks.

items.title: Russia launches major drone and missile attacks on Kyiv
items.feedTitle: Blackouts and water shortages in Kyiv after Russia strikes Ukraine’s energy grid
items.summary: Russia conducted a major overnight attack on Kyiv using 172 drones and 36 ballistic missiles, targeting electricity substations and key infrastructure. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy accused Moscow of trying to "plunge Kyiv and the entire country into a blackout." The assault follows weeks of escalating attacks on Ukraine's energy grid ahead of planned negotiations.

items.title: Qatar pursues UN nuclear inspections plan as Strait reopens
items.feedTitle: Strait of Hormuz could reopen as part of Qatari plan for Iran nuclear inspections
items.summary: Qatar, acting as lead mediator in U.S.-Iran tensions, is seeking to persuade Tehran to allow UN nuclear weapons inspectors to visit Iran's bombed nuclear sites. The diplomatic initiative comes as part of a broader framework that could include reopening the Strait of Hormuz. Both sides have engaged mediators in recent days amid threats of escalation.

items.title: Kenya cult leader sentenced to 200 years for 191 murders
items.feedTitle: Kenya cult leader handed 200-year sentence for 191 murders
items.summary: Kenyan courts sentenced Paul Mackenzie, a cult leader, to 200 years in prison for orchestrating the deaths of 191 people, including many children. Mackenzie ordered his followers to starve themselves and their children to death in a forest so they could "meet Jesus." The case represents one of the deadliest cult-related mass murders in recent African history.

items.title: India lands heavy-lift aircraft at world's highest altitude
items.feedTitle: World's highest IL-76 landing, Nyoma makes mark as India's key airbase on the LAC
items.summary: The Indian Air Force successfully landed an IL-76 heavy-lift military transport aircraft at Nyoma airbase in Ladakh at 13,600 feet, marking the world's highest-altitude landing for this aircraft type. The achievement underscores India's strategic military capabilities in the region bordering China. Nyoma has emerged as a critical airbase for India's defense posture on the Line of Actual Control.

items.title: Andhra Pradesh CM orders swift relief after Cyclone Murasu
items.feedTitle: Cyclone Murasu: Andhra Pradesh CM orders swift power restoration, price control measures
items.summary: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu ordered immediate power restoration and price control measures in response to Cyclone Murasu's impact on the state. Officials were directed to monitor field-level relief operations, complete damage assessments quickly, and ensure prompt financial assistance to affected families. The cyclone caused significant disruption across the coastal state.

items.title: Trump celebrates Diwali at White House with Indian-American leaders
items.feedTitle: Donald Trump celebrates Diwali at White House with Indian-American leaders, top CEOs
items.summary: President Trump participated in Diwali celebrations at the White House, welcoming Indian-American community leaders and top business executives. The event highlighted Trump's outreach to Indian-Americans during Diwali, the Hindu festival of lights. Participants included prominent members of the Indian diaspora and corporate leadership.

items.title: Delhi world's most polluted major city before Diwali
items.feedTitle: Delhi world's most polluted major city on eve of Diwali, Swiss group says
items.summary: Delhi has been designated as the world's most polluted major city by a Swiss air quality monitoring group on the eve of Diwali celebrations. Air quality in parts of the capital has reached "severe" levels, with forecasts predicting further deterioration around the festival. The pollution crisis compounds public health concerns during one of India's most important festivals.

items.title: Ex-Tech Mahindra executive shot dead in parking dispute
items.feedTitle: Tech Mahindra’s ex-Asia head shot dead over parking row in Faridabad, neighbour arrested
items.summary: A former Asia-Pacific head of Tech Mahindra was shot dead in Faridabad in a dispute over parking and a dog, with a neighbor arrested for the killing. The victim was shot nine times in the altercation. The incident highlights urban tensions in Delhi's satellite cities and has drawn national attention.

immigration.title: DHS ends automatic extensions for employment authorization documents
immigration.feedTitle: Removal of Automatic Extensions for Certain Employment Authorization Documents
immigration.summary: A finalized interim final rule by the Department of Homeland Security, published October 30, 2025, and in effect, ends the automatic extension of employment authorization documents (EADs/Form I-766) for aliens who have timely filed renewal applications in certain employment categories. Workers must now actively renew rather than relying on automatic extensions. This change directly impacts employment-based visa holders, including H-1B workers and their families.

immigration.title: Democrats may reverse H-1B restrictions after midterm victories
immigration.feedTitle: Can Democrats reverse Trump's H-1B policies? What US midterms mean for immigrants
immigration.summary: With Democrats gaining control of Congress after the midterm elections, there is renewed discussion about potentially reversing or modifying Trump-era H-1B visa restrictions that have limited hiring of foreign skilled workers. Immigration advocates and Indian-American groups hope the shift in power could lead to policy changes on work visas. However, lawyers caution that immediate relief is unlikely given legislative timelines and the lame-duck period.

immigration.title: US green card backlog hits record 1.56 million applications
immigration.feedTitle: More than 1.56 million US green card applications face backlog
immigration.summary: USCIS data shows more than 1.56 million U.S. green card applications are currently pending, a record backlog that disproportionately affects employment-based and family-based immigration. The accumulation reflects years of processing delays and visa number limitations. Family-based cases comprise the largest portion of the backlog, followed by employment categories.

items.title: Tech stocks plunge on AI regulation fears after Democratic sweep
items.feedTitle: From high-flying AI stocks to tariff-hit alcohol companies, the midterms shook up Wall Street
items.summary: U.S. stock markets experienced significant volatility after Democrats' decisive midterm victories, with tech and AI stocks leading a major sell-off. The Nasdaq plunged 5% as investors worried that Democratic control of Congress could lead to stricter AI regulation and slower development of data centers. The sell-off erased trillions in market value, particularly affecting high-flying AI companies like Nvidia.

items.title: Berkshire Hathaway accelerates buybacks as operating profit falls
items.feedTitle: Berkshire Hathaway accelerates stock buybacks, operating profit falls
items.summary: Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway more than doubled its stock buybacks in the third quarter even as operating earnings declined. The company repurchased billions in shares, signaling confidence in valuation despite challenging business conditions. The aggressive buyback strategy contrasts with softening profitability amid broader market uncertainties.

items.title: The S&P 500 Is Up 75% In 3 Years. Priced In Gold, It Is Down 14%. Which Is Real?
items.feedTitle: The S&P 500 Is Up 75% In 3 Years. Priced In Gold, It Is Down 14%. Which Is Real?
items.summary: Summary unavailable for this update.

items.title: Indian markets surge despite global tech turmoil
items.feedTitle: Indian markets surge as Sensex, nifty defy global tech turmoil | Business News
items.summary: The Sensex and Nifty 50 posted their strongest weekly gain since 2021, rising over 8% despite a major sell-off in global tech stocks triggered by midterm election results. Indian markets defied the broader tech downturn as foreign institutional investors reallocated capital away from U.S. AI stocks. The rally marks a decoupling of Indian equities from the global tech-heavy decline.

items.title: Tesla halts Cybertruck production, pivots to robotics
items.feedTitle: Tesla to wind down Cybertruck production as Elon Musk focuses on robotics and AI
items.summary: Elon Musk announced Tesla will wind down production of the Cybertruck to redirect its Texas factory toward manufacturing the Cybercab, the company's self-driving taxi. The decision marks the effective end of the Cybertruck program after years of hype and divisive customer reception. The pivot reflects Musk's strategic focus on autonomous vehicles and AI over traditional vehicle production.

finance.note: Oil markets remain volatile amid U.S.-Iran tensions and Trump's "minor" strikes on Iranian air defense systems, with traders uncertain about supply disruptions. U.S. stocks rebounded Friday after Thursday's tech-driven sell-off but posted their fourth consecutive weekly decline as Nasdaq investors reassess AI spending amid Democratic midterm victories and growing political opposition to data centers. Indian equities surged over 8% for the week, defying global tech turmoil as foreign funds rotated away from U.S. AI stocks. cards.title: Constraints spark invention
cards.insight: The most creative breakthroughs often emerge not from unlimited resources but from working within tight boundaries. Scarcity forces prioritization, eliminates noise, and demands that every element earn its place—whether in a three-minute song, a 140-character tweet, or a team with half the budget of competitors.
cards.takeaway: When facing constraints, reframe them as creative challenges rather than obstacles. Ask: "What becomes possible precisely because of these limits?"

cards.title: Remix beats pure novelty
cards.insight: True creativity rarely invents from nothing. The most memorable innovations—from jazz to hip-hop to modern visual design—combine existing elements in surprising new ways. Audiences often respond more to a fresh arrangement of the familiar than to the utterly alien.
cards.takeaway: Study combinations: What two unrelated ideas, tools, or traditions could yield something unexpected when merged?

cards.title: Permission to fail accelerates discovery
cards.insight: Cultures and individuals that tolerate failed experiments produce more innovations. Edison's thousands of failed bulb filaments weren't wasted effort—each revealed what didn't work, narrowing the search space. Perfectionism before trying kills ideas in the cradle.
cards.takeaway: Build a "failure quota" into your process: aim to try five ideas knowing two or three will flop, making the survivors more robust.

cards.title: Boredom is creativity's fuel
cards.insight: Constant stimulation and distraction hijack the mind's ability to make unexpected connections. The brain's default mode—activated during boredom, walks, or routine tasks—is when divergent thinking flourishes. Idle time is not wasted time.
cards.takeaway: Schedule "thinking time" without screens or input. Some of your best ideas will arrive when you're not actively chasing them.

ai.title: Anthropic IPO faces headwinds as AI backlash grows post-midterms
ai.feedTitle: Anthropic IPO meets AI backlash after midterms show stinging rebuke of data centers
ai.summary: Anthropic's planned initial public offering, initially valued at $1.5 trillion, faces significant challenges after the Democratic midterm sweep triggered a major sell-off in AI stocks. Investors are increasingly concerned that Democratic control of Congress could lead to stricter regulation and restrictions on data center expansion, a core infrastructure need for AI companies. Valuation expectations have dropped as high as $1.1 trillion, and some investors suggest postponement may be prudent given market conditions.

ai.title: OpenAI raises $11 billion at $1.25 trillion valuation
ai.feedTitle: OpenAI Secures $11B In Funding As Valuation Reaches $1.25T: Report
ai.summary: OpenAI has secured an additional $11 billion in funding at a $1.25 trillion valuation, below its original $1.4 trillion target, according to reports. The funding round reflects investor appetite despite recent market turbulence around AI stocks and regulation concerns. The company's lower-than-hoped valuation underscores mounting skepticism about AI hypergrowth assumptions.

ai.title: Midterm backlash threatens AI industry expansion plans
ai.feedTitle: How a Blue Wave midterm might reshape the AI industry
ai.summary: Democrats' historic midterm victories and voter rejection of data center expansion in 40 of 41 ballot measures pose significant obstacles to the AI industry's growth trajectory. Public opposition to massive energy-intensive data centers has become a political liability, with communities pushing back on infrastructure projects. Meta, OpenAI, and other AI labs now face a tougher regulatory environment and public resistance to their expansion plans under Democratic-controlled Congress.

ai.title: Anthropic's unreleased model solves quantum computing conjecture
ai.feedTitle: An unreleased Anthropic model just helped solve a major quantum-computing question
ai.summary: An unreleased Anthropic AI model reportedly helped solve a longstanding 18-year-old quantum computing conjecture in just three days, according to recent reports. The breakthrough demonstrates potential capabilities of advanced AI systems in mathematical and scientific problem-solving. The achievement comes as Anthropic prepares for its public market debut amid renewed scrutiny of AI capabilities.

ai.title: Dropbox acquires Tigris Data for $350 million to boost AI
ai.feedTitle: Dropbox acquires Tigris Data for $350M to bolster its AI infrastructure
ai.summary: Dropbox announced its acquisition of Tigris Data for $350 million to strengthen its AI infrastructure capabilities. The deal is intended to support development of DBX Agent Cloud, a new storage platform aimed at developers building AI models and agents. The acquisition reflects cloud storage companies' strategic pivot toward AI-native infrastructure.
